headline: Classes and Government Work Suspended in NCR and 14 Provinces for August 18
seoTitle: Walang Pasok Aug. 18: NCR, 14 Provinces | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News brief reports suspensions of in-person classes and standard government on-site work across NCR and 14 provinces for August 18 amid Habagat rains.
deck: The emergency measures expand across Luzon as heavy monsoon rain continues to create flood and travel risks.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News overnight package reports that in-person classes and standard government on-site work were suspended across Metro Manila and 14 provinces for Tuesday, August 18.
The package cites the Office of the President, disaster authorities and weather advisories as the basis for the expanded precautionary measures.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The suspension package was issued during an extended period of enhanced Southwest Monsoon rainfall. Essential and frontline services remain subject to separate operational requirements.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: School and work suspension orders directly affect commuting, public-service access and household safety decisions during severe weather.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Residents should follow the latest Palace, LGU, school and agency notices because coverage and resumption arrangements can change by locality and function.
